name: Science (PCM - Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics)
undergraduateOptions: B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science, AI & DS, ECE, Mechanical, Aerospace)
description: The premier gateway to engineering, computing, architecture, defense, and analytical technology careers.
pros: Highest volume of high-paying tech jobs
High flexibility to switch into finance/business later
Global recognition
cons: High coaching expenses in private sector

name: Science (PCB - Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
description: The quintessential route for healthcare, medical sciences, biological research, pharmaceuticals, and diagnostics.
pros: Direct societal impact and respected profession
Resilient healthcare industry demand
Diverse clinical & research paths
cons: Extreme competition (24+ lakh aspirants for ~1 lakh MBBS seats)
Long gestation period before high earnings (5.5 yrs + MD/MS)

name: Science (PCMB - Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology)
undergraduateOptions: B.Sc / B.Tech in Computational Biology & Bioinformatics
description: A rigorous dual-option stream offering maximum flexibility across both engineering and medical/bio domains.
pros: Zero regrets: eligible for both JEE and NEET
Ideal for emerging intersectional fields (Genomics, MedTech, Prosthetics)
Strong scientific research foundation
cons: Highest academic workload among all streams
Risk of divided focus diluting competitive percentile in both JEE & NEET

name: Commerce with Mathematics
undergraduateOptions: Integrated BBA + MBA (5-Year IPM at IIMs)
description: Combines corporate economics and commerce with quantitative rigor, opening doors to high finance and leadership.
pros: Direct track to corporate finance, investment banking, and consulting
Shorter years to earning compared to medicine
Lucrative starting salaries in fintech & Big 4
cons: High competition for top colleges (SRCC, St. Xavier's, IIM IPM)

name: Commerce with Informatics / Applied Studies
description: Focuses on commercial principles, entrepreneurship, trade law, and corporate administration without advanced calculus.
pros: Manageable academic stress with high practical applicability
Fast entry into business, family firms, or marketing roles
Strong pairing with Law (CLAT)
cons: Ineligible for pure Economics (Hons) or Actuarial programs requiring 12th math

name: Humanities & Social Sciences
undergraduateOptions: BA (Hons) in Psychology / Economics / Political Science
BA LLB (5-Year Law at National Law Universities)
description: Explores human behavior, law, governance, societal systems, psychology, design thinking, and creative expression.
pros: Direct foundation for high-prestige careers in Law, Civil Services, UX Design, and Policy
Fosters superior communication and critical thinking
Growing industry demand for UX research and cognitive psychology
cons: Starting salaries can vary widely depending on tier of institution and applied portfolio

name: Polytechnic / Vocational Technical Diploma
undergraduateOptions: Direct 2nd Year B.Tech / B.E. (Lateral Entry without JEE!)
Advanced Diploma in Automation / Cloud / Robotics
Direct Junior Engineer / Technician placement in Industry
description: A 3-year hands-on engineering diploma directly after Class 10. Allows direct entry into 2nd year B.Tech, bypassing 11/12th and JEE entirely!
pros: Zero entrance exam stress (no JEE)
Saves 1 year if entering workforce directly
Ultra cost-effective: Govt Polytechnic fee is < ₹15,000/yr
Direct Second Year Engineering entry reservation
cons: Fewer premier tier-1 seats (IITs do not accept lateral entry)
Requires early commitment to a specific technical branch
